## How it was checked

Tick only what you ran.

- [ ] Failing test written first, then passing

## Rules

- [ ] Uses the terms in `CONTEXT.md`
- [ ] Nothing new leaves the device without opt-in; no passwords, form values or keys logged, spoken or sent
- [ ] Spoken wording is short and plain
- [ ] ADR added or updated if a decision changed
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
